episode_title: The End of Days Is in the Prospectus: Anthropic’s IPO, Canva’s Cuts and a Privacy Deadline

real_qa.q: Why did Canva lay off 22% of its workforce and what severance package did it offer?
real_qa.r: Canva laid off 22% of their workforce, but they paid out all employees six months' pay regardless of service, vested all their stocks, let employees keep their devices, and offered $10,000 to $15,000 USD grants to anyone starting their own business. They massively overhired around the COVID crisis and are bringing headcount back to pre-COVID levels, but also faced a real drop-off in user numbers for the first time.

real_qa.q: What is Claude Design and how is it disrupting Canva according to the podcast?
real_qa.r: Claude Design is an Anthropic product that is described as objectively better than Canva and is totally disrupting Canva. To get the best out of Claude Design, you need to use Claude Opus or Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and it does some pretty amazing things, but users are getting subsidized pricing and Anthropic is not charging the true cost of building those tokens.

real_qa.q: What happened with Heidi Health after raising $130 million and achieving unicorn status in September?
real_qa.r: Heidi Health achieved unicorn status in September 2024 and raised another $130 million on a billion-dollar valuation, doubling their previous round. However, six weeks later they laid off 18% of employees and two of their three co-founders left the company. They had rapidly grown from 80 to 600 employees in under two years and hired expensive enterprise sales people to sell into hospitals and large medical companies.
real_qa.requete: Heidi Health unicorn layoffs co-founders left

real_qa.q: What are the key financial metrics for Anthropic's IPO filing?
real_qa.r: Anthropic's target valuation for its IPO is $2 trillion. Their revenue last quarter was $17 billion, up 1,100% year-on-year. They have 12,000 customers spending over $100,000 a year, with a net retention rate of 900%. However, they lost $80 billion in their first quarter last year, equivalent to the market cap of many top 20 ASX companies.

real_qa.q: What disclosure and transparency commitments is Fenora making regarding AI model usage in their products?
real_qa.r: Fenora is committing to be really open in disclosing their AI implementation and will disclose what underlying AI models they are using. Their users won't have to use AI if they don't want to, so they won't be charged for it. They believe vendors will have to disclose this information moving forward because of Privacy Act changes in Australia.
real_qa.requete: Fenora AI model disclosure Privacy Act Australia
